summary: CMB.TECH NV filed a 6-K reporting that its Special General Meeting on October 8, 2026 approved a USD 0.64 per share shareholder distribution, comprising a USD 0.21 intermediary dividend (30% withholding tax unless exempt) and USD 0.43 from available share premium (withholding-exempt). Ex-dividend dates are October 15, 2026 on Euronext Brussels and Oslo Børs and October 16, 2026 on the NYSE, with payment October 22, 2026 and on/about October 27, 2026 for VPS-registered Norwegian shares. The meeting also approved a distribution of minimum USD 50 million and maximum USD 250 million from share premium. Watch capital-return pace and withholding-tax treatment across listing venues.
